title: Llama with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8d5b0'/>
  <rect x='45' y='80' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <rect x='57' y='80' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f0ddb8'/>
  <rect x='63' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8d5b0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='45' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='57' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='63' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='14' height='34' rx='7' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='28' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='16' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#f0ddb8' transform='rotate(-20 38 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='16' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#f0ddb8' transform='rotate(20 64 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='16' rx='2.5' ry='6' fill='#f2b8c6' transform='rotate(-20 38 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='16' rx='2.5' ry='6' fill='#f2b8c6' transform='rotate(20 64 16)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='36' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f9efd8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='35' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#d4b88c'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='35' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#d4b88c'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M49 38 Q51 40 53 38' stroke='#d4b88c' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8b6b3e'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#c9a96e'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='46.5' cy='24.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='43.5' cy='27.5' r='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx='57' cy='26' r='4' fill='#8b6b3e'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#c9a96e'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='58.5' cy='24.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='55.5' cy='27.5' r='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- extra sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M42 20 l1 2 l1 -2 l-2 1 l2 1 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M60 20 l1 2 l1 -2 l-2 1 l2 1 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M39 30 l0.8 1.6 l0.8 -1.6 l-1.6 0.8 l1.6 0.8 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M63 30 l0.8 1.6 l0.8 -1.6 l-1.6 0.8 l1.6 0.8 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#f0ddb8' transform='rotate(30 28 62)'/>
  <!-- fluffy chest tuft -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f9efd8'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='50' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
</svg>
